name: Natalie Boyle
description: Natalie Boyle teaches country line dancing around Long Island, from basic to intermediate steps, with dances that local country bands and DJs play. She has written some line dances of her own and sings and plays percussion in the band Cloud 10 Country.

evidence.note: Lessons page names Natalie Boyle as the teacher and lists her in the band Cloud 10 Country (harmony vocals, percussion, line dance teaching).
Videos page credits a line dance "Girl Like You" to Natalie Boyle.
CopperKnob step-sheet site lists a New York choreographer named Natalie Boyle with 19 dances from 2018 to 2025.

reviewNotes: Added 2026-10-06 (issue #41). She does not publish a home town (directories say Rocky Point), so none is recorded. No social links are on her site.
